input.title: Unisex Police – Off Duty. Still Judging Your Parking. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

OFF DUTY. STILL JUDGING YOUR PARKING. is the police hoodie for the officer who clocked out and still notices every crooked car, worn at the cookout, on the off-duty weekend and as a gift from a spouse.

OFF DUTY. fills the top in tall condensed capitals and STILL JUDGING YOUR PARKING. stacks in two wide lines below. Between them a man in a flannel shirt and ball cap sits on a blue cooler holding a hot dog, with a rusty old car parked crooked behind him on a patch of gray pavement.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the scene; Sand gets navy and deep red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this police hoodie warm enough for cookouts and cool evenings?
Yes. The Off Duty. Still Judging Your Parking. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cool evenings, the cookout and the off-duty weekend.

How does the Off Duty. Still Judging Your Parking. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a police officer?
It is a natural one. Every officer has noticed a crooked parking job on a day off, so it lands with deputies, partners and the family who hears about it. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the cooler scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Off Duty. Still Judging Your Parking. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
